Title: Toxicity prediction across the Tox21 panel with semi-supervised learning
Description: Reports activity across the twelve Tox21 endpoints, seven nuclear receptor signals and five stress response pathways, using a graph convolutional network trained with the Mean Teacher semi-supervised algorithm. Chen and colleagues paired the 7,831 labelled Tox21 compounds from MoleculeNet with some 50,000 unlabelled structures taken from ClinTox, SIDER, ToxCast and HIV, raising the average test ROC-AUC to 0.757. The endpoints are heavily skewed towards inactives, so a positive call carries more information than a negative one.
Interpretation: Probability of activity in each of twelve Tox21 nuclear receptor and stress response toxicity assays.
